no_adcom_quote.quote: An Advisory Committee (AC) meeting was not convened for this application. Benralizumab is the third product targeting the IL-5 pathway for the treatment of asthma. The general issues about the appropriate population, the role of eosinophils in determining treatment, the risk-balance considerations for biologics such as this anti-IL 5 for asthma have all been discussed before at AC meetings. Benralizumab did not present any new safety concerns that would warrant discussion at an AC meeting.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for FASENRA (benralizumab, BLA761070). The FDA Division Director Summary Review and Medical Review both state that no AC meeting was held, reasoning that benralizumab was the third anti-IL-5 product for asthma and that the relevant issues (appropriate population, role of eosinophils, benefit-risk of anti-IL-5 biologics) had already been discussed at prior Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee meetings, with no new safety concerns warranting discussion. Because no committee was convened, there are no AC-driven linkages to the approval.
